third_party_evaluations.summary: FortiGate day-to-day admin: policies, NAT, VPN, SD-WAN, FortiGuard services and HA.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Daily policy, VPN, SD-WAN and HA administration at one year fits an associate operator; the recorded proctored exam remains specific to FortiGate rather than general security architecture.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded daily policy, NAT, VPN, SD-WAN and availability operations fit associate firewall administration. The one-year profile and proctored vendor exam do not establish advanced cross-platform security delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded policies, NAT, VPN and high-availability administration scope fits a one-year platform operator. Deployment relevance supports associate placement, while product dependence limits portability.
